_note: Snapshot of mavis mcp list on 2026-09-25. 9 servers total.

servers.name: tradingview
servers.description: TradingView unofficial MCP server — stock screener API for stocks/forex/crypto/ETFs (no API key)

servers.name: yahoo-finance
servers.description: Yahoo Finance MCP server — real-time quotes, historical prices, financials, analyst ratings, options, news (no API key)

servers.name: tradingview-advanced
servers.description: Advanced TradingView MCP — 30+ tools, real-time data, technical indicators, screeners, backtesting, sentiment, Yahoo Finance integration (no API key)
servers._cloud_action: Substitute uv.exe → Linux `uv` in YAML; pin version (currently runs via uv.exe on Windows)

servers.name: financekit
servers.description: FinanceKit MCP — 17 tools: stock quotes, technical analysis (RSI/MACD/Bollinger/Golden-Death Cross), crypto via CoinGecko, VaR/Sharpe/Sortino/Beta, correlation matrix, options chains, earnings calendar, sector rotation, portfolio analysis. No API keys.
servers._cloud_action: Substitute uvx.exe → Linux `uvx` in YAML; pin version

servers.name: shibui-finance
servers.description: Shibui Finance — pre-loaded 64-year dataset for 9,900+ US equities: 31M+ daily prices, 56 technical indicators, financials, SEC filings, earnings surprises. Plain English → SQL. No API key.

servers.name: deepgram-stt
servers.description: Deepgram Nova-2 speech-to-text via stdio MCP. Exposes transcribe_file (local audio/video) and transcribe_url (public HTTPS URL, no local download). Returns plain text or speaker-labeled paragraphs (diarize=true).
servers._cloud_action: Verify Python runtime + DEEPGRAM_API_KEY env support in cloud MCP config

servers.name: discord
servers.description: Discord (fmarcac/discord-mcp) — reads your own Discord desktop client via DevTools Protocol. 18 tools: channels, threads, forum posts, search, DMs. Works for any server you are a member of (no bot needed). ToS-sensitive — read-only defaults.
servers._cloud_action: DO NOT PORT — requires local Discord desktop client via DevTools Protocol

servers.name: stocktwits
servers.description: StockTwits social sentiment via Pipeworx hosted MCP gateway — 9 tools (symbol_stream, user_stream, trending_symbols, trending_messages, suggested_symbols, symbol_search, chart_data, watchlists, watchlist). Keyless public read endpoints via the gateway (200 req/hr/IP). Direct StockTwits API returns 403 from many regions; the gateway bypasses that.

servers.name: finviz
servers.description: Finviz.com screener via Playwright. Free tier: regular-session Change %, Rel Volume, snapshot, news, insider. Elite (set FINVIZ_USER/FINVIZ_PASS env): pre-market % column.
servers._cloud_action: Add `playwright install` hook before first MCP call to install browser binaries in cloud sandbox
